note: Israel: a foreign artist works on the B/1 work visa as a foreign expert, through the engaging company, usually for no more than three months and never past a year, for the length of the project (a law firm's guide to the Population and Immigration Authority's rules, the Authority's own pages not reached). No days of performing without it are named.

sources.title: Decker, Pex, Levi Law Offices, Israeli Work Visa for a Foreign Artist
sources.said: Foreign artists are often issued visas for a shorter period of time, generally a maximum of three months. At the same time, a longer visa may be issued, but the Population and Immigration Authority stipulates that the visa for a particular foreign artist should not extend past one year at any given time.
